items.body: Red warehouse at Apollo Aggregates, east of Hamlet, South Vice-Dale County, north of Key Lento. 1) Enter the warehouse, go to the back office: take the cocaine from the desk and open the safe. 2) Fill the first stash bag. 3) In the middle area, take the second stash bag from the open van and fill it with cocaine from the other vans (including outside). 4) Store BOTH stash bags in the trunk of your personal vehicle. 5) Pause, Game, Save Game (a separate manual slot). 6) Load that save — the warehouse loot respawns, the trunk keeps its contents. 7) Repeat. 8) Sell at Brian's Lockup, south-west of Key Lento (keypad code 7700). About $8,640 per loop; the first loop is about $11,000–$11,280. Needs a personal vehicle with a trunk; best from Chapter 2 (much Chapter 1 money is lost in the story transition). Never leave bags on the ground or carry them during the reload — they can vanish. Always store them in the vehicle first.
items.contra: afleurdenet (20 Nov): no working infinite-money glitch exists right now, and most money-glitch videos are fake (old GTA Online footage or phishing cash-generator sites — NEVER enter PSN, Xbox or Rockstar credentials on a third-party site). vanotherlevel (18 Nov): as of 18 Nov, no outlet had reported a working GTA 6 money or duplication glitch.
items.pro: KeeNgamer and allblogthings (20 Nov) report it works on the launch build.
items.title: Apollo Aggregates warehouse money glitch (DISPUTED)

items.body: The fastest legit money is the 8 large bank vaults — up to $205,000 per bank. That covers the $160,000 for all 8 garages and the $100,000 of shopping with room to spare. Randy's Wish List also pays top dollar for the 16 wanted sports cars.
items.title: Legit money instead: bank vaults

items.body: Loop the 5-second shooting range to raise Focus fast. Higher Focus makes Gunslinger and The Shootist much easier.
items.title: Focus farm (5 seconds)

items.body: The train tunnel north of Ambrosia is the best 4-star escape: police struggle to follow on the rails and helicopters cannot see you. Best for Hot Together and for escaping after bank vaults.
items.title: Train tunnel escape

items.body: Stand on a busy road and scan every passing vehicle with WAiNK. Whip It Good and the 200 scans for 100% finish almost by themselves.
items.title: Scan cars from a busy road

items.body: Meditate as Jason AND Lucia at the same spot for +2 progress — it halves the 18-spot grind.
items.title: Double meditation

items.body: Work out with your partner present: while one character works out, the other progresses automatically, doubling Strength progress for Personal Best.
items.title: Work out together

items.body: In the Chapter 1 weapons mission, clerk Andrew gives a 50% discount on the Fortune & Son Moreland 850 shotgun ($350 instead of $700) because Jason is ex-military — and the discount stays if you come back later.
items.title: 50% shotgun discount

glitch_farming.status: REPORTED — 2 sources for, 2 against, not fully verified, may be patched at any time

items: Day-one patches v01.002.000 (13 Nov, about 1.07 GB PS5 / 2.18 GB Xbox) and v01.002.001 (16 Nov, about 602.5 MB PS5 / 1.6 GB Xbox). Rockstar published NO patch notes for either. Both are required before playing.

PSN outage on the night of 18 Nov (hours before unlock): failed logins, server errors, download problems. About 10,000 reports in the US and 6,000 in the UK at peak. Fixed by Wednesday midday. This was Sony's side, not a game bug.
0 trophies glitched, according to PowerPyx. No trophy has been reported as unable to pop.
No verified in-game bug list from any outlet as of 18–20 Nov. The game is rated very polished for its size.
Frame-rate drops: target is 30 FPS, with drops in dense areas while driving, on all consoles including PS5 Pro. There is no 60 FPS or performance mode.
Rumor of a Rockstar apology and a fix on 25 Nov: a viral X post, with NO support on Rockstar's official channels (Newswire / support) as of 21 Nov. Treat as unverified.
Some physical copies shipped without a download code, or with a code that could not be redeemed or was already used (reported since 13 Nov; some buyers got replacements).

roadmap.body: Play all 5 chapters. Do the balcony meditation in Chapter 1 before it ends (Positive Mental Attitude — the only missable trophy). Save manually at the start and end of every chapter: there is no mission replay and no New Game+.
roadmap.title: Story + the Chapter 1 meditation

roadmap.body: Finish the 6 stranger final missions (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) plus the 8 counted Strangers & Freaks strands (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete). All are available after the story.
roadmap.title: Stranger questlines

roadmap.body: Crimes with your partner: 4-star escape (Hot Together), 3 shops back-to-back (Retail Therapy), 5 kills in one Combat Focus (Gunslinger), the VCIA plane (Catch Me If You Can), the Rhino tank (Challenging Tank), the silent jewelry robbery (Sneakthief), the Ocean View cocktail (In The Beginning…), 500 Criminal Profile actions, and the Ten Pin best lead.

Then Vice Got a Price! pops.
roadmap.title: 100% checklist cleanup → Platinum

save_strategy.body: There is no mission replay and no New Game+. You have 15 manual slots plus 1 autosave. Save at the start AND end of every chapter (10 saves), and rotate the remaining 5 slots during free-roam cleanup. Never overwrite your only chapter-start save, and be careful overwriting saves mid-cleanup. The autosave does not always run in the prologue or at certain checkpoints, and the save menu does not show autosaves — use the load menu to find them.
save_strategy.title: Save strategy — no mission replay

warnings.body: Constant extreme violence pushes your Criminal Profile to Irredeemable, and it never goes back. Police become more aggressive and shoot on sight. The other profiles (Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho) are not permanent. Avoid grinding Actions Speak Louder by mass-killing civilians.
warnings.title: Criminal Profile Irredeemable is PERMANENT

warnings.body: Do not use cheats on your platinum save. The cheat menu reportedly opens only after all story missions are finished, and while a cheat is active you cannot save and trophies do not pop in that session. Rockstar has not published an official cheat list; the reported count of about 61 cheats is NOT verified.
warnings.title: Cheats disable trophies AND saving

warnings.body: Missed the Chapter 1 meditation? Without a Chapter 1 save, the only fix is a new playthrough. Keep chapter-start saves.
warnings.title: No mission replay — one save is not enough
